customer: I'm moving to Dunmore for a new job in a couple of weeks and I really don't have time to deal with booking appointments just to sell my pickup truck. Every place I call wants me to schedule something days out. Can I just show up at one of your stores and get a number, or is that another runaround?
agent: No appointment is needed. You can walk into any Northwind store and a specialist will inspect your pickup while you wait, usually in 30 to 45 minutes, then give you a written quote that's valid for 7 days or 300 miles. If you accept, you can finish the sale during the same visit, so please bring your photo ID, registration and title, or your payoff information if you still have a loan, as listed in our What to bring guide.
